name: KOVACIC, Maria

headline.note: The official record documents a 2006–2021 ANZ-linked mortgage franchise and a 2016–2019 advisory partnership, but not hours, leave, exact overlap or substantive full-time status. Board, association, community, party, study and elected roles are excluded. General claims of earlier public-sector experience lack employer and date detail; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.employer: ANZ Bank mobile lending franchise (legal franchise entity unresolved)
career_spells.role: Franchise business owner in mortgage and finance services
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract supplies January 2006 to 30 November 2021 and describes Kovacic as an ANZ Bank franchise business owner. Party and local profiles corroborate that she founded and ran a mortgage and finance business for about sixteen years. The legal entity, exact January start day, hours, leave, staffing and overlap with advisory and governance roles are unresolved. First speech describes long hours and weekend work, but no hours threshold, dated pattern or leave. Advoc8 names Mobile Home and Investment Solutions Pty Ltd from 2007; primary register/employer link not verified, so legal entity and its differing start remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private self-employment is well supported, but substantive full-time status and non-overlapping time are not established.

career_spells.role: Board member, Board Chair and President
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen extract supplies month boundaries and combined board titles. The organisation's 2021 annual report identifies Kovacic as leading the board. Remuneration, title transitions, meeting load and any operational employment are not stated; governance is not assumed to be paid employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Nonprofit governance is displayed separately and excluded from the narrow public/private employment headline.

research_notes: The frozen official month/day boundaries are preserved; no dates are inferred from the phrase 'sixteen years' where a more precise official range exists.
ANZ brand affiliation does not make the franchise owner an ANZ employee; the role is coded as private self-employment with the legal franchise entity unresolved.
Managing Partner is not treated as proof of full-time work, especially because the entire Western Sydney Advisory interval overlaps the ANZ franchise and several governance roles.
Board, committee, association and party titles are displayed but not treated as employment without evidence of remuneration and substantive duties.
A party biography claims more than twenty years across commercial, public and not-for-profit sectors, but supplies no public employer, dates or role; that missing career segment remains unresolved.

2026-10-01 follow-up adds separately evidenced Executive Women and Committee for Western Sydney roles and National Library Council appointment; first speech supplies qualitative workload evidence only. No full-time interval inferred from long hours/weekends.

Searched ANZ franchise, earlier public-sector employment, advisory company and public-profile leads. ABR later Shoshanna business-name dates are not evidence of 2016–2019 employment; mortgage company-name lead uncorroborated and profile contains conflicting childhood details. ABR name-search URL inaccessible; individual Shoshanna record read. Reject unrelated same-name construction/food profiles and Deputy President Kovacic tribunal decisions. Pre-2006 employer history remains unresolved.
open_questions: What work did Kovacic perform before January 2006, particularly the claimed public-sector experience, and for which employers and dates?
What was the ANZ franchise legal entity, exact January 2006 start day, hours, leave and staffing model?
What were Kovacic's equity, remuneration, hours and leave at Western Sydney Advisory, and how were hours allocated against the ANZ franchise?
Were any Hills Community Aid, Western Sydney Women, Eels, FCA or Croatian Women roles remunerated or operational employment rather than governance?
What were the title transition dates within Hills Community Aid and the separate relationship, dates and remuneration status of Western Sydney Executive Women?
Was the 2022 Parramatta candidacy or NSW Liberal presidency remunerated, and how did each overlap other work?
Can original company/credit-representative records verify the Mobile Home and Investment Solutions Pty Ltd lead and 2007 claim against official January 2006 franchise start?
Which employer/client and dates account for banking Royal Commission response work, and did it overlap Western Sydney Advisory?
What were Committee for Western Sydney membership and Western Sydney Executive Women founding/end dates, original legal forms and remuneration?
What remuneration and meeting load apply to National Library Council governance?
